notes.title: ROLLING BACK THE VOICE UPDATE!!!!
notes.content:
Hi! i rolled back the voice update because it corrupted a bunch of voice files. Everything should sound as originally intended now. Enjoy! Maybe I'll patch in a way to switch versions; but I would rather you guys just have the original game. Thank you very much!

notes.title: MALINE 3.4.1 - THE MALINE VOICE UPDATE!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577892/54008ccd945db86356eb1a47c42480c338b1a24a.png[/img]

We have heard your cries!

We have seen your wincing!

We have watched you play!

Maline's a bit too loud...

So this update, turns her down significantly (only the peaks, the super loud peaks. everything else should be just fine).

Let me know if everything sounds great, and if not, I'll roll it back to the previous version. Thanks for playing Maline!

The reception has been incredible so far! I appreciate you guys more than you know! 

Biggest update download size yet, at a staggering ~200mb. wow. huge amirite?

Okay see you later! Love you!

-Ani Meida

notes.title: New Maline Avatars!
notes.content:
Hi! I just added some avatars to Steam and I wanted to take a sec to credit and link to all the incredible artists that provided the artwork.

[h1]Artist's Alley[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577892/a5e5c6267148564e42da32cffc0f2aecf90829f9.png[/img]

This image is by [url=https://bsky.app/profile/penzles.bsky.social]Penzles[/url], who also voiced Bunni Snails! She's a wonderful artist and a brightly shining talent all around. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577892/76030c6a5308e387a62d8434b966a245dfe0f217.png[/img]

This avatar is by [url=https://kikicpu.art/]Kiki Antonette[/url], who voiced Key and is also currently working on the Happy Devil Girl logo. Give it UUUUP! She also worked on my official VTuber logo, my 3D model, emotes, and more. She's just great!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577892/aaf5efa6086dcc09638cbae92a4a909bdbfac787.png[/img]

This image is by [url=https://bsky.app/profile/kumquatcat.bsky.social]Kumquat / s41[/url], the art director on SUPER UNDERWRLD - The sequel to Maline currently in development. They're super amazing and just a bundle of sweetness and fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577892/e52e4d3b17bd8fba2ae44610bd89f174f24492a1.png[/img]

This image is by [url=https://bsky.app/profile/dreizerel.bsky.social]Dreizerel[/url], one of the most amazing artists [url=https://vgen.co/Dreizerel]I've met on VGen[/url]. His process is so beautiful to watch and he works so quickly, informing you every step of the way. I'm in love with his Yuri art. Check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577892/19dd08ac0f8eb0b8d7fce6721cb2c334a7f2a191.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577892/685d73dbb1a72cafffaf9790e9421ff4ef7cab44.png[/img]

And these are [url=https://ani-meida.carrd.co/]by me![/url]


Thanks for reading and I hope you enjoy the game!! It's out now, so give it a play!!

Thank you and with you forever in robotness,
Ani Meida

notes.title: Maline Voice Actor Panels!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Y7IO3sGYDjc;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi everyone!! Wow!! Maline releases tonight! and Trailer #2 dropped on YouTube!

It's been a year-long, hard-fought journey of Kindness, demons, heroes, and villains...

but it's also been one of the best experiences of my life working alongside some of the greatest friends i've ever made !! Working with them on this project was such a fun, powerful learning experience and I had SO much fun just sharing space with them. I'm SO thankful for them- Having people in my life is so amazing, I'm unspeakably grateful for all of my friends that hung out and put their heads together with me on this project!!! ːtobdogː

This weekend, you'll get a chance to hangout with them too!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577892/261c49f976ed918890977c3b613f30dcf1c64c4c.png[/img]

[h1]At the official Maline VA Panels![/h1]

We have lots of awesome events planned!! Like:

[list]
[*] Gaming in character!
[*] Reading scripts and hanging out!!
[*] Answering your questions about the game!
[*] Miscellaneous Improv!!!!!!!!
[/list]

So!!!

I hope you'll[url=http://twitch.tv/ani_meida] join us on my Twitch[/url] for the broadcasts on Wednesday & Saturday!!

Dates and times in the image! Let's have a lot of fun!!!

I'm looking into putting the OST onto Steam as DLC, but right now you can [url=https://animeida.bandcamp.com/album/maline-original-soundtrack]purchase it on Bandcamp![/url]

Your favorite robot definitely because nobody else could possibly be that to you,
Ani Meida
